## What this changes

Describe the result for Herald users, and why it's needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused on one change; an issue was agreed first for anything substantial.
- [ ] Security, privacy, compatibility and cost impact described (or none).
- [ ] No credentials, machine-specific paths, logs, browser captures or private prompts included.
- [ ] User-facing changes noted for the changelog.
